eval_cases.description: UC-1.1: Grounded hardware diagnostic protocol for ERR-PAY-4001 EMV PIN Pad freeze with double-charge prevention and citation.

parts.text: What is the immediate field recovery protocol when a cashier encounters an ERR-PAY-4001 EMV contactless payment freeze, and how do we ensure the customer is not double-charged?

eval_cases.reference: Follow Toshiba TCx 810 Guide: Do NOT re-swipe card. Hold Yellow + # on PIN pad for 3 seconds to reboot. Check 12V PoweredUSB cable. In Manager Menu -> Journal Audit Slip, check if status is AUTHORIZED_UNSETTLED (print receipt) or VOIDED_ERROR (re-scan). Include link to Toshiba_TCx_810_Guide.pdf.

eval_cases.description: UC-1.1: Technical manual retrieval for Diebold Nixdorf thermal printer cutter lock error ERR-DN-PRNT-24V.

parts.text: How do store clerks resolve a terminal thermal printer cutter lock error code ERR-DN-PRNT-24V on Diebold Nixdorf BEETLE A1150 POS terminals?

eval_cases.reference: Refer to Diebold Nixdorf BEETLE A1150 Service Guide. Power off 24V PoweredUSB line, manually rotate manual cutter emergency thumb-wheel clockwise, inspect paper path for thermal roll jams, and clean sensor optics. Include certified document citation.
